hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path ROADMAP.md) { Select-String -Path ROADMAP.md -Pattern '^## Open bugs' -Context 0,12 }"
powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Output 'PRE-COMPACT: run /handoff now. What is half-done and why is about to be summarised away; the journal is the only place it survives.'"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$c = git status --short; $d = $c -match '^.. (docs/|ROADMAP\.md|CLAUDE\.md)'; $o = $c -notmatch '^.. (docs/|ROADMAP\.md|CLAUDE\.md)'; if ($o -and -not $d) { Write-Output 'Code changed this session, no doc did. Check the table in .claude/skills/doc-ritual/SKILL.md: decision -> decisions.md, hour lost -> gotchas.md, switch flipped -> features.md, code removed -> History/.' }"
